title: GFlowQEC: Generative Flow Networks that Learn to Sample Quantum LDPC Codes
abstract: arXiv:2611.06819v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Choosing a quantum error-correcting code for a real device means scoring candidates with circuit-level simulations so slow that only a few hundred can be run. So every evaluation counts, and a search is judged by how many good codes it finds per paid evaluation. Quantum LDPC codes built from a few group elements protect many logical qubits, but good ones are rare in a huge space. We introduce GFlowQEC, to our knowledge the first generative flow network (GFlowNet) for quantum code design. It builds a code one group element at a time and learns to propose codes in proportion to a power of their score. We train it once on scores from earlier searches, freeze it, and let it propose lifted-product codes with 180 physical qubits, scored by their distances. Ranking ten of its draws per paid call, it finds more than twice as many new top-scoring codes (inequivalent to any it was trained on) as tuned parallel tempering, even when tempering star

translated_title: GFlowQEC：学习采样量子LDPC码的生成流网络
translated_abstract: 为真实设备选择量子纠错码，意味着需要用电路级仿真对候选码进行评分，而这类仿真极其缓慢，只能运行几百次。因此每一次评估都弥足珍贵，搜索方法的好坏取决于它在每次付费评估中能找到多少个优质码。由少数群元素构建的量子LDPC码可以保护多个逻辑量子比特，但优质的码在巨大的搜索空间中十分稀有。我们提出了GFlowQEC，据我们所知，这是首个用于量子码设计的生成流网络（GFlowNet）。它每次添加一个群元素来逐步构建码，并学习按照候选码得分的幂次成比例地提出新码。我们使用来自早期搜索的得分对模型进行一次训练，然后将其冻结，让它在180个物理量子比特的规模上提出提升乘积码，并以码距作为评分标准。在每次付费调用中对其十个采样结果进行排序，它找到的新的最高分码（与训练中见过的任何码均不等价）数量是经过调优的并行回火算法的两倍以上，即使回火算法……
tldr: 提出首个用于量子码设计的生成流网络GFlowQEC，它学习按得分比例采样生成量子LDPC码，在昂贵的电路级仿真评估预算下，找到的全新高分码数量是并行回火方法的两倍以上。
en_tdlr: GFlowQEC, the first GFlowNet for quantum code design, learns to sample quantum LDPC codes proportionally to their score and finds more than twice as many new top-scoring codes as tuned parallel tempering under a limited budget of costly circuit-level simulations.
